symptom: A valid pinned environment file with one reserved assignment let an activated turn acquire its person's lease, then strict child-variable validation failed both the turn and terminal. The same file worked in legacy mode.
rule: A file's accepted bytes are distinct from its exportable process variables. Exercise the signed carrier, real leases, filesystem and child process together; retain private file bytes while excluding names that cannot be exported (principles 10, 11 and 13).
